description: Points a subdomain of the merchant's domain (for example survey.example.com) at UserLoop's Cloudflare for SaaS fallback origin, fallback.user-loop.com, so it serves the merchant's UserLoop link and email surveys. UserLoop's custom hostname uses HTTP validation, so this one CNAME record is the only record needed.
variableDescription: No variables. Apply with host set to the subdomain (for example host=survey on domain=example.com); the record is created at that host.
